capabilities: watch a configured folder for newly saved clipping files
launch a tmux window running claude "/ingest <path>" on each new file
convert clippings into knowledge-graph notes via the /ingest skill
configure the watch folder and toggle auto-ingest
disambiguation: It does not clip or process articles itself; it only watches a folder and launches Claude Code to do the ingestion.
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node.js child_process to run tmux and claude); the plugin itself makes no network requests but Claude Code sends content to Anthropic's API. Requires copying a /ingest SKILL.md into the vault, and the skill's paths must be updated if the watch folder changes. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed by manually copying main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css.
problem: Clippings saved by Obsidian Web Clipper sit as raw files until you manually run an AI processing step to turn them into wiki knowledge-graph notes.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Web Clipper is used to save an article to e.g raw/clippings/
watches a folder for new clippings and automatically triggers Claude Code's /ingest skill

summary: Folder watcher that automatically triggers Claude Code's /ingest skill on new web clippings saved into a vault folder.
